name: Revit Export QA Pack

meta.title: Spaces should have a Number
meta.why: Space numbers drive schedules, wayfinding, and coordination.
meta.howToFix: Fill the Space/Room Number in the authoring model before export.

meta.title: Spaces should have a Name (attribute or Identity Data)
meta.why: Space names help coordination and downstream reporting.
meta.howToFix: Populate the Space/Room Name; ensure it exports to Name or Identity Data.

meta.title: Phase Created should be a known value
meta.why: Consistent phase values reduce ambiguity during QA and handoff.
meta.howToFix: Standardize phase names in the authoring model or mapping before export.

meta.title: Phase Created should be a known value
meta.why: Consistent phase values reduce ambiguity during QA and handoff.
meta.howToFix: Standardize phase names in the authoring model or mapping before export.

meta.title: Phase Created should be a known value
meta.why: Consistent phase values reduce ambiguity during QA and handoff.
meta.howToFix: Standardize phase names in the authoring model or mapping before export.

meta.title: Scheduled phase should match Phase Created
meta.why: Cross-pset consistency prevents conflicting phasing data.
meta.howToFix: Align Identity Data 'Scheduled' with Phasing 'Phase Created' for the element.

meta.title: Scheduled phase should match Phase Created
meta.why: Cross-pset consistency prevents conflicting phasing data.
meta.howToFix: Align Identity Data 'Scheduled' with Phasing 'Phase Created' for the element.

meta.title: Doors should have an ID (Mark or Type Mark)
meta.why: Door identification supports schedules, tagging, and issue tracking.
meta.howToFix: Set Mark on instances or Type Mark on the door type.

meta.title: Windows should have an ID (Mark or Type Mark)
meta.why: Window identification supports schedules, tagging, and coordination.
meta.howToFix: Set Mark on instances or Type Mark on the window type.

meta.title: Space Name should meet basic naming rules
meta.why: Catches blank/garbled names and improves consistency.
meta.howToFix: Use alphanumerics with simple separators; avoid special characters.

meta.title: Door Mark should follow a consistent pattern
meta.why: Consistent mark patterns reduce scheduling/tagging errors.
meta.howToFix: Adopt a Mark naming convention (e.g., D101, DR-01) and apply it consistently.

meta.title: Door Type Mark should follow a consistent pattern
meta.why: Type marks support type-based scheduling and QA.
meta.howToFix: Adopt a Type Mark convention and apply it to door types.

meta.title: Door instance Comments should align with Type Comments
meta.why: Prevents conflicting notes between instance and type data.
meta.howToFix: Keep instance comments empty unless overriding type comments; otherwise sync both.

meta.title: Walls should have a Name
meta.why: Element names improve model review, issue tracking, and downstream reporting.
meta.howToFix: Populate the wall Name in the authoring model before IFC export.

meta.title: Doors should have a Name
meta.why: Door names help identify elements during QA review and coordination.
meta.howToFix: Populate the door Name in the authoring model before IFC export.

meta.title: Windows should have a Name
meta.why: Window names help identify elements during QA review and coordination.
meta.howToFix: Populate the window Name in the authoring model before IFC export.

meta.title: Elements should not share the same GlobalId
meta.why: Duplicate GlobalIds break reliable element tracking, issue linking, and model comparison workflows.
meta.howToFix: Regenerate or repair IFC export identifiers so each IFC root object has a unique GlobalId.

meta.title: Walls should be assigned to a spatial container
meta.why: Spatial containment connects elements to levels, buildings, or spaces and supports model navigation and filtering.
meta.howToFix: Check the authoring model level/story assignment and re-export with spatial containment enabled.

meta.title: Doors should be assigned to a spatial container
meta.why: Spatial containment helps locate doors by building, story, or space during coordination.
meta.howToFix: Check the door host and level/story assignment before IFC export.

meta.title: Windows should be assigned to a spatial container
meta.why: Spatial containment helps locate windows by building, story, or space during coordination.
meta.howToFix: Check the window host and level/story assignment before IFC export.

meta.title: External spaces should have boundary relationships
meta.why: External space boundaries support spatial analysis, envelope checks, and model coordination.
meta.howToFix: Review space boundary export settings and confirm the external space is properly bounded in the authoring model.

meta.title: Walls with volume should also report length
meta.why: A positive wall volume without length suggests incomplete quantity export or inconsistent base quantity data.
meta.howToFix: Review wall quantity export settings and confirm base quantities are included in the IFC export.

description: Rules tuned for common Revit-to-IFC export patterns (identity/phasing/type fallback, naming/mark conventions). Rule IDs use the 'RV-' prefix for Revit export checks.
